source.title: Democrats Begin Outlining Priorities
source.description:
On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondents Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz discuss the dust settling on Tuesday's midterm elections. On today's show, Democratic Congressman Sam Liccardo of California, White House Council of Economic Advisers Chairman Chris Phelan, Stonecourt Capital Partner Rick Davis, Harvard Kennedy School Ash Center Visiting Democracy Fellow Jeanne Sheehan Zaino and former Republican Congressman Patrick McHenry.
